name: NYDFS 23 NYCRR 500 Financial Cybersecurity Compliance
description: Compliance framework for the New York Department of Financial Services Cybersecurity Regulation (23 NYCRR 500), covering 72-hour incident reporting, 24-hour extortion payment reporting, MFA mandates, CISO annual certifications, and Class A business controls.
owner: New York Financial Regulatory & Cybersecurity Office

checklists.name: NYDFS 23 NYCRR 500 Control Verification Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for NYDFS Part 500 sections 500.01 - 500.24.

items.statement: Cybersecurity policy is reviewed annually and approved by a Senior Officer or Board of Directors (§500.03).
Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) is enforced for all individuals accessing nonpublic information (§500.12).
Cybersecurity events are reported to the NYDFS Superintendent within 72 hours of determination (§500.17(a)).
Ransomware extortion payments are reported to NYDFS within 24 hours of payment (§500.17(c)).
Vulnerability assessments are performed at least bi-annually and penetration testing conducted annually (§500.05).

reviewGates.name: NYDFS Section 500.17 CISO Certification Gate
reviewGates.statement: The CISO confirms that MFA, penetration testing, and incident reporting comply with NYDFS 23 NYCRR 500 requirements.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the cybersecurity audit package support full CISO certification under NYDFS Part 500?
